name: smwmusic-last-bible-iii-central-of-the-world-underworld-forest-remix
title: Last Bible III - Central of the World ~ Underworld Forest (Remix)
description:
Decided to make my 200th port upload on this site something special similar to my Air Man Remix in February, so I did a special remix of SMWC's National Anthem Underworld Forest from Last Bible III.

History Of The SMWC National Anthem
Six years ago, legendary porter Nanako made a port of this song, and little did anyone know that it'd change the entire Super Mario World industry. Nearly every SMW hack had this theme in it in some way or form. You could not escape it, even if you tried. And to make things worse, a year ago, other legendary porter Samantha made an unsampled port to add to the chaos. SMWCentral has never been the same since. What was once an innocent web site for gamers who wanted to express their love for the amazing Super Mario World has now turned into an Underworld Forest cult. SMWCentral deprived themselves of their Super Mario World content in order to please the Underworld Forest god with using this song in their hacks. This site is stuck in an endless cycle of torture of making sure this song was engraved into our brains, note for note, and us porters are forced to port / arrange this song or else our end will come. This is not just an end of an era. but it's the true end of... The Time-when-Underworld-Forest-wasn't-a-thing Days...


Jokes aside though, this song's absolutely fantastic (and so are those ports). There's a reason why so many people love using it, and I hope I was able to spice things up with my take on this awesome theme for my special! :D

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch, Listening-Only)
2. B Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. C Minor (Original Pitch)
2. A# Minor (Custom Pitch)
